# contains place

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:containsPlace`](gmeow-containsPlace.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/containsPlace>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

The inverse of [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) — a place that geographically contains another place. Under OWL 2 semantics, transitivity is entailed because [`containedInPlace`](gmeow-containedInPlace.md) is transitive. GMEOW does not assert additional transitive property chains beyond the inverse declaration; transitive closure is a solver concern ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).
